made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/musica-sheet-make.js, from musica-set.html (window.MUSICA.E) and the design of La música (the orchestrator's p10-spec, general rules and section musica). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 74. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is laid out square to the picture: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), the fort's wall at v 0; plaza-base.js PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 74 + 13 v - 22.5 z; the picture holds u from -4.62 to 4.62
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the floor; z 0.28: the stage's top; z 0.74: a músico's stool on the stage; z 0.46: the bench's seat and the floor stool) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). A small thing has a box (the spot's box): a thing that hangs (the guitar, the drum, the paper notes) has its top middle on the point (the box [sx - floor(w / 2), sy, w, h]); the microphone has its bottom middle on the floor at the point (the box [sx - floor(w / 2), sy - h, w, h]). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 53 rows drawn standing for a grown-up (a 56-row canvas whose lowest row is empty); the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); abuela standing mkAbuela (48 x 51): column 30; abuela sitting mkAbuelaS (52 x 50): column 17 (her middle) and row 36 (her lap) on (sx, sy), the spot being the seat; a grown-up sitting (mkPersona with sent = 1): column 24 and the lap row, the bottom of the hips: row 16 + 2 t + 3 (t 11 a grown-up: 41; t 7 a child: 33) on (sx, sy), the spot being the seat's top (the músicos on their stools: z 0.74); a small thing: see spot. The camera on the frog's chest: things.camara.px from the frog's spot. Nobody is drawn turned: whoever sits faces us
rules.view: one window, wide, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture, x0 = its left edge (22 centres it). Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character

setKey.note: one state: the set draws one frame (nothing sways: window.DEPTH.z is the baked depth). The sheet's numbers are read from the set as it is

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the stage's front, the bench and the stools hide what is behind them by more than the bias. A thing that hangs is the plane through its spot.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where bakedZ[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias (bakedZ: window.DEPTH.z of the set page). The upright plane through the feet; a thing that hangs from its top middle has its plane through the same point (a pixel below the point is nearer the ground by the same slope)
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias; two planes within 0.001 are a tie and the later layer is drawn

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the floor (z 0). The spec gives no radius: these are El cruce's (frog .45, grown-ups .35, children .28) (open point)
shadows.onSeat: whoever sits on a stool or the bench, or stands on the stage (z above 0) casts none: none of those is floor (a shadow cast at the floor under them would show in front of them); the things that hang cast none; the microphone casts none (a sprite on the floor: open point)
